subject: https://bakobo.com

titles.en: ACDC credential schemas, published by Bakobo at a separate origin

delegationNote: A delegation is a hint and conveys no trust. It records that Bakobo also publishes at the named origin, which saves a lookup; it is not an endorsement, and a consumer should evaluate that origin exactly as it would have without this document. Bakobo has incepted no organisational AID, so there is nothing to sign a stronger claim with and an unsigned one would be forgeable by anyone who could replace this file.
